mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo_check_intent (member_id, session_id, action_key, request_fingerprint, context_json, image_reference, reservation, original_day, nonce, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sessionId}, #{actionKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{contextJson}, #{imageReference}, #{reservation}, #{originalDay}, #{nonce}, 'PREPARED', NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM photo_check_intent WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND action_key=#{actionKey}
SELECT * FROM photo_check_intent WHERE id=#{id} AND request_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE photo_check_intent SET state='IN_FLIGHT', updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND request_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND state='PREPARED'

UPDATE photo_check_intent SET encoded_input_sha256=#{encodedInputSha256}, model_name=#{modelName}, prompt_version=#{promptVersion}, encoder_version=#{encoderVersion}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint} AND state='IN_FLIGHT' AND encoded_input_sha256 IS NULL

UPDATE photo_check_intent SET state='RESULT_READY', provider_state=#{providerState}, reason_code=#{reasonCode}, result_pass=#{resultPass}, result_confidence=#{resultConfidence}, result_reason=#{resultReason}, result_degraded=#{resultDegraded}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint} AND state='IN_FLIGHT'

UPDATE photo_check_intent SET state='UNKNOWN', provider_state='UNKNOWN', reason_code='EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN', updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND request_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND state='IN_FLIGHT'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_check_intent i JOIN play_attempt_log p ON p.id=#{attemptLogId} AND p.member_id=i.member_id AND p.idempotency_key=i.action_key AND p.request_fingerprint=i.request_fingerprint AND p.attempt_type=8 WHERE i.id=#{id} AND i.request_fingerprint=#{fingerprint}
mapper.update: UPDATE photo_check_intent SET state='APPLIED', attempt_log_id=#{attemptLogId}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND request_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND state='RESULT_READY'
